not connected

Start the server, then serve dist/:

cargo run --features server --bin cms-server -- 4433 ~/Dropbox/org-mode-files

python3 -m http.server --directory dist 8080

The server writes its cert next to the page, so this connects on its own. If it doesn't (server not running from the repo, or a different host), paste the printed cert sha-256 — or open with #cert=<hash>:
